Nobiscum] Hoc est, mecum & cum aliis San-

omnis & benedictio Dei spiritualis in Christo
quæcunque in communione est, neque datur
nisi ei qui locum aliquem obtinet in societate

page.notes: The asterisk in the text ("quo-que*") is the reference mark of the marginal note "impar.", which is printed in the right margin; the transcription keeps it as printed. The page number "265" is uncertain: the final digit is printed in an old form that resembles a long s, so it is read as 5 (please verify). The word "tertio" and the ligatures in "afflictio" and "excellenter" are read from the scan. The signature "R v" is at the foot. Printed spellings "disfimilis", "posfit", "Thef" and "s"-forms are normalised to s as per the rules.
